name: verify_stockReference_audit_columns_by_id
note: stock_reference: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM stock_reference ORDER BY id

name: verify_stockReference_scalar_listing
note: stock_reference: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, name FROM stock_reference ORDER BY id

name: verify_stockReference_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: stock_reference: per-parent count of each embedded array (stock_reference_move_rel, stock_reference_purchase_rel, stock_reference_sale_rel) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_moverel, COALESCE(e1.n, 0) AS n_purchaserel, COALESCE(e2.n, 0) AS n_salerel FROM stock_reference r LEFT JOIN (SELECT reference_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_reference_move_rel GROUP BY reference_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT reference_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_reference_purchase_rel GROUP BY reference_id) e1 ON e1.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT reference_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_reference_sale_rel GROUP BY reference_id) e2 ON e2.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
